status: Distinct multi-timeframe setup architecture; known data, not unused validation
hypothesis: 4h structural swings define a meaningful Fibonacci objective, while15m rejection execution keeps local stopped risk smaller. Prior tests on30m/60m single charts did not test this separation.
structure: Aggregate canonical15m candles to complete UTC4h candles. On completed4h close, detect first close cross of previously confirmed structural pivot in direction of its current EMA50 slope/price trend, before updating newly confirmed pivots. Opposite confirmed4h pivot anchors origin. Deliver break and closed4h extreme only to15m bars starting at or after4h completion.
pullback: Track subsequent completed15m extremes from known4h extreme; freeze prior endpoint on first50% touch, skip candles that both extend and touch. Minimum impulse is2 times ATR14 frozen at4h breakout. First50-61.8 touch rejects directionally on touch or immediately next15m candle. Setup expires192 entry bars(48h); prior4h EMA trend and origin must hold.
execution: One-tick stop beyond15m rejection wick; fixed stop beyond15m two-candle pullback extreme+0.15 local15mATR. Target frozen impulse endpoint.
